name: Price Alerts for WooCommerce
author: Devnet

sections.description:
Price Alerts for WooCommerce lets your customers subscribe to product price drops and get notified when the price falls below their chosen target. Ideal for stores that want to boost conversions on high-interest items, this plugin offers a smooth subscription experience, supports both simple and variable products, and lets you control exactly when and to whom price drop emails are sent — all from your WordPress dashboard.

Set it up in minutes, customize to fit your theme, and start growing your list of interested buyers.

Features

  • Customers can subscribe to price alerts directly on product pages
  • Works seamlessly with both simple and variable products
  • AJAX-enabled frontend for smooth, no-reload interactions
  • You decide who gets notified and when — send Price Drop emails manually from the dashboard
  • Fully translatable and developer-friendly for customization

Early Development Notice

Price Alerts is in the early stages of development, and we’re actively working to expand its features. Future updates will include support for additional features and deeper integrations.

Your feedback is invaluable! If you have specific needs or suggestions, please share them in the support forum. We appreciate your support and look forward to improving Price Alerts with your input.
sections.installation:
Installation from within WordPress

  1. Visit Plugins > Add New.
  2. Search for Price Alerts.
  3. Install and activate the Price Alerts plugin.

Manual installation

  1. Upload the entire price-alerts folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Visit Plugins.
  3. Activate the Price Alerts plugin.

After activation

Visit the new Price Alerts > Settings menu.
Setup the plugin and enable the form.
